say:1:1111300101:0.text: I told you to leave! Outlanders are not welcome around here!
say:1:1111300101:0.source_cn: 我都说了，赶紧离开！这里不欢迎外人！

say:2:1111300102:0.text: Ugh... I'm too injured to waste my breath on the likes of you. Now, beat it!
say:2:1111300102:0.source_cn: 哎哟！疼疼疼……你也看到了，我受了点伤，不想和你们多说...

choice_prompt:3:1111300102.text: Ugh... I'm too injured to waste my breath on the likes of you. Now, beat it!
choice_prompt:3:1111300102.source_cn: 哎哟！疼疼疼……你也看到了，我受了点伤，不想和你们多说废话。你们快走吧！

say:4:1111300103:0.text: Would you believe me if I told you a monster did this to me?
say:4:1111300103:0.source_cn: 我说这是怪物打的，你信吗？
say:4:1111300103:0.male: Would you believe me if I told you a monster did this to me?
say:4:1111300103:0.female: Would you believe me if I told you a monster did this to me?

say:5:1111300104:0.text: Just last night, a group of strange monsters wandered into our village.
say:5:1111300104:0.source_cn: 就在昨天晚上，有几只行踪诡异的怪物路过村子。

say:6:1111300105:0.text: They nearly scared the hell out of me while I was on watch. Good thing I'm pretty quick on my feet, or else I'd be dead.
say:6:1111300105:0.source_cn: 我当时正在守夜，吓了一大跳！要不是我跑得快，我已经没命了！

say:7:1111300106:0.text: If you ask me, this place isn't safe anymore. Alkali's probably our safest bet right now.
say:7:1111300106:0.source_cn: 要我说，这地方已经不安全了，应该去咸水镇住一阵。

say:8:1111300107:0.text: With that many people in the town, we should be able to take care of each other. But the thought of sharing the town with outlanders is just... ugh.
say:8:1111300107:0.source_cn: 起码那边人多，大家互相之间能有个照应。但是，我又不喜欢...

say:10:1111300108:0.text: You're worried about me...? Guess you're not such a bad person after all.
say:10:1111300108:0.source_cn: 你是在关心我……哼，你这人还挺好。
say:10:1111300108:0.male: You're worried about me...? Guess you're not such a bad person after all.
say:10:1111300108:0.female: You're worried about me...? Guess you're not such a bad person after all.

say:11:1111300109:0.text: Here's a friendly word of caution. Turn around and go back to where you came from. There's no telling what kind of trouble is waiting up ahead.
say:11:1111300109:0.source_cn: 那我也好心提醒你们一句，别再前进了，那边不知道出了什么...
say:11:1111300109:0.male: Here's a friendly word of caution. Turn around and go back to where you came from. There's no telling what kind of trouble is waiting up ahead.
say:11:1111300109:0.female: Here's a friendly word of caution. Turn around and go back to where you came from. There's no telling what kind of trouble is waiting up ahead.

say:12:1111300110:0.text: Last night, I saw the monster come into the village!
say:12:1111300110:0.source_cn: 就在昨天晚上，那怪物都来到村子里了！

choice_prompt:13:1111300110.text: Last night, I saw the monster come into the village!
choice_prompt:13:1111300110.source_cn: 就在昨天晚上，那怪物都来到村子里了！

say:14:1111300111:0.text: It was too dark. I couldn't see it clearly.

say:15:1111300112:0.text: From what I did see, it was a figure shrouded in mist, walking strangely... It was enough to turn my blood cold.
say:15:1111300112:0.source_cn: 你可不能说我眼神不好，因为那怪物好似一团雾，身形奇怪，...
say:15:1111300112:0.male: From what I did see, it was a figure shrouded in mist, walking strangely... It was enough to turn my blood cold.
say:15:1111300112:0.female: From what I did see, it was a figure shrouded in mist, walking strangely... It was enough to turn my blood cold.

say:0:1111300201:0.text: I wonder what kind of monster it was.
say:0:1111300201:0.source_cn: 这些人提到的怪物是什么呢……

say:0:1111300301:0.text: Ah, the sand... it's getting into my fur!
say:0:1111300301:0.source_cn: 好大的风沙啊……我的毛毛里全都是沙粒！

say:1:1111300302:0.source_cn: 怎么不把碍事的毛剃掉呢？

say:2:1111300303:0.text: No way! I don't want to look like a hairless hamster!
say:2:1111300303:0.source_cn: 不要！我才不想当无毛鼠！

say:0:1111301001:0.text: Magister! There are wild terrabirds up ahead!
say:0:1111301001:0.source_cn: 主人！前面又有狂乱的陆行鸟！
say:0:1111301001:0.male: Magister! There are wild terrabirds up ahead!
say:0:1111301001:0.female: Magister! There are wild terrabirds up ahead!

say:1:1111301002:0.source_cn: 它们好像特别凶狠，小心呀！

say:1:1111303002:0.text: She's unconscious and badly hurt. We need to find a safe place right now!
say:1:1111303002:0.source_cn: 她晕过去了，伤得不轻……我们得找个地方休养。

say:2:1111303003:0.text: Follow me! I know where to go!

say:0:1111304001:0.text: Another village full of children, just like the last one.
say:0:1111304001:0.source_cn: 和之前的村子一样，全是小孩。

say:1:1111304002:0.text: I'm not sure if they'll be able to help, but let's ask around.
say:1:1111304002:0.source_cn: 不知道他们是否能提供帮助，四处问问看吧。

say:2:1111305001:0.text: Oh no, what happened to her? We have to stop the bleeding! Come with me! I have some herbs back home!
say:2:1111305001:0.source_cn: 哎呀，这位大姐姐怎么受伤了？得赶快止血才行！我家有草药！

say:3:1111305002:0.text: What a kind little girl! Thank you so much...
say:3:1111305002:0.source_cn: 谢谢，你真是个善良的孩子……

say:4:1111305003:0.text: Where did Mama put those herbs? I just need a second to find them...
say:4:1111305003:0.source_cn: 咦，妈妈把草药放哪了？我得好好找一找。

say:6:1111305005:0.text: I can't find them... The house has gotten too messy to find anything since Mama's not here...
say:6:1111305005:0.source_cn: 不行啊……妈妈不在，家里乱糟糟的，什么都找不到……

say:8:1111305006:0.text: This must be how you feel, Chippy. If it weren't for Dolly, your room would be a total pigsty!
say:8:1111305006:0.source_cn: 和满满一样嘛，要不是多莉经常帮忙收拾，满满的房间连个落...

say:11:1111305007:0.text: Your room's no different! The floor's practically covered with potions and notebooks!
say:11:1111305007:0.source_cn: 你的房间不也一样吗？魔法药剂堆得到处都是！

say:12:1111305008:1.text: Hey, it's not my fault! I was born a hamster...
say:12:1111305008:1.source_cn: 没办法……谁叫我是一只仓鼠呢？

say:13:1111305009:1.text: Don't worry, little girl. We'll help you look for them!
say:13:1111305009:1.source_cn: 小朋友，你不要着急，我们来帮你。

say:14:1111305010:1.text: Or rather, Magister Merlin, can you help? Dolly taught you how to organize and tidy up, right?
say:14:1111305010:1.source_cn: 梅林！交给你啦，多莉说她曾经教过你如何整理。
say:14:1111305010:1.male: Or rather, Magister Merlin, can you help? Dolly taught you how to organize and tidy up, right?
say:14:1111305010:1.female: Or rather, Magister Merlin, can you help? Dolly taught you how to organize and tidy up, right?

choice_prompt:15:1111305010.text: Or rather, Magister Merlin, can you help? Dolly taught you how to organize and tidy up, right?
choice_prompt:15:1111305010.source_cn: 梅林！交给你啦，多莉说她曾经教过你如何整理。
choice_prompt:15:1111305010.male: Or rather, Magister Merlin, can you help? Dolly taught you how to organize and tidy up, right?
choice_prompt:15:1111305010.female: Or rather, Magister Merlin, can you help? Dolly taught you how to organize and tidy up, right?

say:16:1111305011:0.text: Come on, Magister. This is easier than magic.
say:16:1111305011:0.source_cn: 这比魔法简单多啦，你一定没问题！
say:16:1111305011:0.male: Come on, Magister. This is easier than magic.
say:16:1111305011:0.female: Come on, Magister. This is easier than magic.

say:18:1111305012:0.text: Do you really expect me to move all this stuff with my tiny hands, Magister Merlin?
say:18:1111305012:0.source_cn: 梅林，你看我的手这么小，根本拿不住这些东西。
say:18:1111305012:0.male: Do you really expect me to move all this stuff with my tiny hands, Magister Merlin?
say:18:1111305012:0.female: Do you really expect me to move all this stuff with my tiny hands, Magister Merlin?

say:19:1111305013:0.text: You know I'd love to help, but all I can give is moral support right now!
say:19:1111305013:0.source_cn: 我也很想帮你……但是，我只能帮你加油了！你一定没问题！
say:19:1111305013:0.male: You know I'd love to help, but all I can give is moral support right now!
say:19:1111305013:0.female: You know I'd love to help, but all I can give is moral support right now!

say:2:1111306001:0.text: Our home is finally nice and clean again! Mama is going to be pleased when she gets back.
say:2:1111306001:0.source_cn: 家里终于恢复整洁啦！妈妈回来就不会训我啦。

say:3:1111306002:0.text: Here, these herbs will help to stop the bleeding. Take them and help your friend.
say:3:1111306002:0.source_cn: 这是止血的草药，总算找到了，送给你们。

say:6:1111306004:0.text: All she needs now is rest. Satrana should be back on her feet soon.
say:6:1111306004:0.source_cn: 接下来只需稍加休息，萨忒娜应该会很快醒过来。

say:7:1111306005:0.text: My house is too small for everyone to stay, but maybe <style="highlight">Rhys</style> has room for you.
say:7:1111306005:0.source_cn: 我家里太小了，没地方让你们歇息，你们去<style=h...

say:9:1111306006:0.source_cn: 诡草？在你们这个氏族，大家的名字还挺奇特。

say:10:1111306007:0.text: Rhys is incredible! He's the best beast tamer in the whole desert!
say:10:1111306007:0.source_cn: 诡草大哥很了不起，他是这片沙漠里最厉害的驯兽师！

say:11:1111306008:0.text: The Quicksand Claws kept pestering him about his terrabird training techniques. But when he turned them down, they kidnapped him!
say:11:1111306008:0.source_cn: 流沙之爪都要向他询问驯养陆行鸟的技巧，他不肯教，流沙之...

say:16:1111306011:0.text: Do you know Rhys? That's great! I'm sure he'll be happy to see you.
say:16:1111306011:0.source_cn: 难道你们认识诡草哥哥？那就更好啦，他见到你们一定会很惊喜！

say:2:1111308001:1.text: Get to the good part, Rhys! Tell us how you defeated the Quicksand Claws!
say:2:1111308001:1.source_cn: 诡草大哥，你说重点嘛！仔细说说你是怎么打败流沙之爪的！

say:3:1111308002:1.text: Well, as you all know, I'm a professional terrabird trainer! So, while I was taking care of their terrabirds, I was secretly raising my own terrabird army!
say:3:1111308002:1.source_cn: 你们也知道，我可是驯养陆行鸟的专家！我一面给他们养鸟，...

say:4:1111308003:1.text: Wow! A whole army of terrabirds!

say:5:1111308004:0.text: That's right, and my beloved <style="highlight">Plumecharger</style> here was their fearless commander!

say:6:1111308005:0.text: Tell us more! What happened next?

say:7:1111308006:1.text: Well, on the night of the blood moon... I led my legion of feathered warriors straight into Ferranc's camp!
say:7:1111308006:1.source_cn: 然后啊……在那红月高升的夜晚……我率领陆行鸟军团冲进了...

say:8:1111308007:1.text: Boom! Bang! I fired off six rounds, one after the other!
say:8:1111308007:1.source_cn: 嘭！我开了一枪、两枪、三枪、四枪、五枪、六枪！总共六发子弹！

say:9:1111308008:0.text: After the shooting stopped, the only ones left standing were me and my terrabird army!
say:9:1111308008:0.source_cn: 这时候，整个大本营内，只剩下我和陆行鸟军团还站着不倒！

say:17:1111308012:0.text: Hello again, Rhys. Your tall tales have only gotten taller lately, haven't they?
say:17:1111308012:0.source_cn: 喂，那个叫诡草的。你的肺不错啊，很擅长吹牛。

say:20:1111308013:0.text: Who's callin' me a liar?! I'm gonna... Oh, hey... What are you guys doing here?
say:20:1111308013:0.source_cn: 谁说我吹牛——怎、怎么是你们几个？！

say:21:1111308014:1.text: We didn't expect to run into the birdkeeper of the Quicksand Claws here.
say:21:1111308014:1.source_cn: 我也没想到会和你再见，流沙之爪的养鸟人。

say:22:1111308015:1.text: Who are you calling a birdkeeper?! Show some respect! Terrabirds are the pride of the desert! They're not just ordinary birds!
say:22:1111308015:1.source_cn: 什么养鸟人啊！不准用那种称呼叫我！\n陆行鸟可不是普通...

say:23:1111308016:1.text: Wait, that's not the point...! You guys shouldn't be here. Get out of here!
say:23:1111308016:1.source_cn: 不对……重点不是这个！\n你们怎么会在这？快给我滚蛋！

say:25:1111308017:0.source_cn: 诡草大哥，他们是什么人呀！

say:26:1111308018:1.text: They're just... a bunch of lucky prisoners who managed to escape from the Quicksand Claws!
say:26:1111308018:1.source_cn: 这个……那个……他、他们是侥幸从流沙之爪手底下逃出来的俘虏！

say:27:1111308019:1.text: If it wasn't for me, they would've been vulture meat.
say:27:1111308019:1.source_cn: 要是没有我，估计早被老鹰吃掉了！

say:29:1111308021:0.text: B-But that's history... There's no point digging up the past.
say:29:1111308021:0.source_cn: 都、都过去了……大家好不容易离开那个地方，这些破事就别...

say:30:1111308022:0.text: I'm not the one who brought up the past.

say:31:1111308023:0.text: You all look like heroes, too. Just like our Rhys!
say:31:1111308023:0.source_cn: 大哥哥，你们也很棒！也是凯旋的英雄呢！

say:32:1111308024:0.text: We were just about to throw a big party in his honor. Why don't you join us? Stop looking so angry, Rhys. They're guests.
say:32:1111308024:0.source_cn: 我们正准备给诡草大哥举行庆功宴会！你们也一起庆祝吧！不...

say:33:1111308025:0.text: ...Alright, a party sounds nice. I'll leave him alone.
say:33:1111308025:0.source_cn: ……好吧，看在你们的面子上，不跟那家伙计较了。

choice_prompt:34:1111308023.text: You all look like heroes, too. Just like our Rhys!
choice_prompt:34:1111308023.source_cn: 哇！大哥哥，你们也很棒！也是凯旋的英雄呢！

say:35:1111308026:0.text: If they cry, it gets troublesome.
say:35:1111308026:0.male: If they cry, it gets troublesome.
say:35:1111308026:0.female: If they cry, it gets troublesome.

say:36:1111308028:0.text: I didn't agree to them joining my party! Why do they get to come?!
say:36:1111308028:0.source_cn: 谁要和他们一起庆祝！我不同意！

say:39:1111308029:0.source_cn: 糟了糟了！诡草大哥不好啦！

say:40:1111308030:0.text: Can't you see I'm in the middle of something? What is it now?
say:40:1111308030:0.source_cn: 怎么了……别大惊小怪，没看见我正忙着吵架吗！

say:41:1111308031:0.text: The little terrabirds you saved all ran away!
say:41:1111308031:0.source_cn: 诡草大哥，你救回来的小陆行鸟都跑了！

say:42:1111308032:0.text: What?! Didn't I tell you guys to keep an eye on them?!
say:42:1111308032:0.source_cn: 什么？说了一百次让你们看好！

say:43:1111308033:0.text: I'll deal with you later, bear breath! I got bigger business to attend to!
say:43:1111308033:0.source_cn: 哼！熊耳朵！回头再跟你算账，我有事先忙！

choice:34:0:1.text: You're not good with kids, huh?
choice:34:0:1.male: You're not good with kids, huh?
choice:34:0:1.female: You're not good with kids, huh?

choice:34:1:2.text: Did you like being called a hero?
choice:34:1:2.male: Did you like being called a hero?
choice:34:1:2.female: Did you like being called a hero?

say:0:1111309001:0.text: Stranger, will you help us find our terrabirds? Please?
say:0:1111309001:0.source_cn: 陌生人，你们愿意帮忙找回陆行鸟吗……拜托了！

say:3:1111310001:0.text: I saved the baby terrabirds from the Quicksand Claws. They lost their parents in battle... Poor feather brains...
say:3:1111310001:0.source_cn: 这些小陆行鸟的爸妈都在战争中……唉，我看它们太可怜……...

say:4:1111310002:1.text: Unfortunately, they're not very used to their new surroundings yet, so they run off every chance they get. They don't know I'm trying to save them.
say:4:1111310002:1.source_cn: 但它们不太适应这里，总想着逃跑。可我没想伤害它们，我是...

say:5:1111310003:0.text: You really like terrabirds, don't you, Rhys?
say:5:1111310003:0.source_cn: 诡草，你很喜欢陆行鸟啊。

say:6:1111310004:1.text: Ha! I get it! You like terrabirds. I like hornleaf bears.
say:6:1111310004:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿！我懂，我也很喜欢叶角熊呢！

say:7:1111310005:1.text: I like all animals, not just terrabirds. Animals are closer to nature than we will ever be. They know things we don't.
say:7:1111310005:1.source_cn: 不止是陆行鸟，我喜欢所有动物！它们很有灵性，什么都懂，...

say:8:1111310006:0.text: My mount, Plumecharger, can sense danger from miles away. She's saved me more times than I can count.
say:8:1111310006:0.source_cn: 我的坐骑叫炽翼冲锋者，它经常能预感到危险，救了我好几次。

say:9:1111310007:1.source_cn: 这些陆行鸟，是我最好的伙伴。

say:10:1111310008:0.text: By the way... Thanks for helping out. I really wasn't expecting it.
say:10:1111310008:0.source_cn: 那个……我没想到你们会帮忙，谢、谢谢。

say:14:1111310010:1.text: Some of your party are hurt, right? You're welcome to stay and rest for the night. We're planning a huge feast, so stick around and eat your fill.
say:14:1111310010:1.source_cn: 你们的伙伴，受伤了对吧？留下休养吧，今晚会有热闹的宴会...

say:15:1111310011:0.text: I'm only doing this because I hate owing people favors! If you guys come for the feast, that makes us even!
say:15:1111310011:0.source_cn: 丑话说在前头，我不喜欢欠人情！你参加了我们的宴会，我就...

say:18:1111310012:1.text: I had no idea you could be that generous, Rhys!
say:18:1111310012:1.source_cn: 看不出来，你还挺讲究的嘛。

say:19:1111310013:1.text: Let's stick around for a bit, Magister Merlin. Satrana needs rest.
say:19:1111310013:1.source_cn: 梅林，稍微留一会儿吧。萨忒娜也需要休息。
say:19:1111310013:1.male: Let's stick around for a bit, Magister Merlin. Satrana needs rest.
say:19:1111310013:1.female: Let's stick around for a bit, Magister Merlin. Satrana needs rest.

say:20:1111310014:1.text: Yes! A feast! I can't wait to eat!
say:20:1111310014:1.source_cn: 好耶好耶！是宴会！喜欢！太期待啦！

say:0:1111311001:0.text: Satrana's awake now, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'll go check on her.
say:0:1111311001:0.male: Satrana's awake now, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'll go check on her.
say:0:1111311001:0.female: Satrana's awake now, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'll go check on her.

say:1:1111312001:0.text: Where are we? Antandra told me I passed out...
say:1:1111312001:0.source_cn: 这是哪里？这么热闹……安丹说我晕过去了。
say:1:1111312001:0.male: Where are we? Antandra told me I passed out...
say:1:1111312001:0.female: Where are we? Antandra told me I passed out...

choice_prompt:2:1111312001.text: Where are we? Antandra told me I passed out...
choice_prompt:2:1111312001.source_cn: 这是哪里？这么热闹……安丹说我晕过去了。
choice_prompt:2:1111312001.male: Where are we? Antandra told me I passed out...
choice_prompt:2:1111312001.female: Where are we? Antandra told me I passed out...

say:5:1111312004:0.text: The feast is about to begin! Come on, let's go!
say:5:1111312004:0.source_cn: 宴会要开始了！正好，一起！

say:6:1111312005:1.text: You better not steal my meat, though!
say:6:1111312005:1.source_cn: 但是，你不能和我抢肉吃！

say:7:1111312006:1.text: Like I would do something like that! By the way, what exactly is going on here?
say:7:1111312006:1.source_cn: 我才没那么无聊！再说……怎么莫名其妙来了一场宴会啊？

say:8:1111312007:1.text: Don't you like feasts? Antandra and I love feasts!
say:8:1111312007:1.source_cn: 你不喜欢宴会？但是安丹姐姐喜欢宴会，我也喜欢！

say:9:1111312008:1.text: Let me play you a song on my flute, Antandra! It's a good one!
say:9:1111312008:1.source_cn: 安丹姐姐，我给你吹笛子听！我会一首热闹的曲子！

say:10:1111312009:1.text: My parents taught it to me before they passed away...
say:10:1111312009:1.source_cn: 这首曲子，是爸爸妈妈去世前教我的！

say:12:1111312011:1.source_cn: 原来你的父母也去世了啊……

say:13:1111312012:1.text: Yeah, but I know we'll see each other again someday. They're definitely waiting for me on the other side.
say:13:1111312012:1.source_cn: 嗯，他们去那边等我了。我知道，总有一天会和他们再见。

say:14:1111312013:0.text: Besides, I still have my clansmen and Antandra, so I'm never alone.
say:14:1111312013:0.source_cn: 而且，卡卡还有族人，还有安丹姐姐！所以，不寂寞！

say:18:1111312015:0.text: Yes! Now, sit back and enjoy my song!
say:18:1111312015:0.source_cn: 嗯！那么卡卡要吹笛子啦！

say:21:1111312016:0.text: Oh, a dinner and a show. Now, this is a real feast! C'mon everyone, a round of applause!
say:21:1111312016:0.source_cn: 哦？有人要开始表演才艺啦。来来来！大家都给点掌声！

say:23:1111312003:0.text: I'm fine, but I can't remember why I passed out.
say:23:1111312003:0.source_cn: 我没事，我都不记得自己是怎么晕倒的了。
say:23:1111312003:0.male: I'm fine, but I can't remember why I passed out.
say:23:1111312003:0.female: I'm fine, but I can't remember why I passed out.

say:3:1111315001:0.source_cn: 到底为什么攻击我们啊！

say:4:1111315002:0.source_cn: 这个旋律……让我很不舒服。

say:6:1111315004:0.text: Soren! Tell Koko to stop playing her flute!
say:6:1111315004:0.source_cn: 索恩！快让卡卡停止吹笛子！

say:17:1111315008:0.text: What in the world is going on...?

say:1:1111317002:0.text: I'm fine, Satrana... Thank you for saving me.
say:1:1111317002:0.source_cn: 多亏了你，谢谢……萨忒娜，是你救了我。

say:2:1111317003:0.text: I wish you'd stop being so polite with me... How's Koko?
say:2:1111317003:0.source_cn: 唉……真讨厌你见外的样子，话说卡卡怎么样了？

say:2:1111318001:0.text: That flute is dangerous! Get rid of it!

say:3:1111318002:0.text: No way! I love this flute! I won't be able to talk to my parents without it!
say:3:1111318002:0.source_cn: 不能扔！这是我的宝物！没了它，我再也不能和爸爸妈妈说话了！

say:4:1111318003:1.text: It's just a flute! How could you talk to them with an instrument?!
say:4:1111318003:1.source_cn: 那是个笛子，你要怎么用它和去世的人说话呀！

say:5:1111318004:0.text: All I have to do is play this flute, and I can hear their voices again!
say:5:1111318004:0.source_cn: 怎么不能！只要用它吹响旋律，就能听见爸爸妈妈的声音！

say:6:1111318005:0.text: I knew you were a bad person! First, you took Antandra away from me, and now you're trying to take my flute!
say:6:1111318005:0.source_cn: 你果然很坏！你抢我的安丹姐姐，还要抢我的笛子！

say:7:1111318006:0.text: Why are you being so stubborn?! I'm trying to help you!
say:7:1111318006:0.source_cn: 你这小孩讲不讲理？我是为你好！

say:9:1111318007:0.text: Calm down, Satrana. Now that the Hypofiend is gone, I sense that it's become an ordinary flute again.
say:9:1111318007:0.source_cn: 萨忒娜，冷静。那个藏在笛子中的魔物被消灭后，这笛子已经...

say:12:1111318008:0.text: Did your parents leave you this flute, Koko?
say:12:1111318008:0.source_cn: 卡卡，这笛子是你父母留给你的遗物吗？

say:15:1111318011:0.text: Far away from here, deep in the Crimson Highlands.
say:15:1111318011:0.source_cn: 在深红高原深处，离这里很远。

say:16:1111318012:0.text: I found it while I was playing out there one day. The Dusk Lord left it for me.
say:16:1111318012:0.source_cn: 前阵子我跑去那边玩，捡到了这个，这一定是残阳神送给我的。

say:17:1111318013:0.text: It was left near where the Dusk Lord sleeps. He must've known that I missed my parents and gave me this flute.
say:17:1111318013:0.source_cn: 因为，那边距离残阳神睡觉的地方不远。残阳神知道，我想爸...

say:19:1111318014:0.text: You were out there by yourself? That's pretty brave.
say:19:1111318014:0.source_cn: 你一个人去那？胆子不小。

say:20:1111318015:0.text: Koko must be talking about the Dusk Lord's final resting place.
say:20:1111318015:0.source_cn: 卡卡说的，应该是残阳神的长眠之地。

say:21:1111318016:0.text: The sacred grounds where the Dusk Lord fell.
say:21:1111318016:0.source_cn: 那是残阳神的陨落之处，是圣地。

say:22:1111318017:0.text: It's strange that Koko would find an evil flute in a place like that...
say:22:1111318017:0.source_cn: 卡卡怎么会在那捡到这样邪恶的笛子？太蹊跷了……

say:32:1111318022:2.text: In a crimson land most high... to the shadowy depths...
say:32:1111318022:2.source_cn: ……于……至高深红之所……去……至暗幽深之处……

say:34:1111318024:0.text: A figure stands... in the shadow...

say:38:1111318027:0.text: Ugh... My head... Did I have one of my visions?
say:38:1111318027:0.source_cn: 呜……头好晕……我刚刚……肯定又说了什么吧。

say:40:1111318028:0.text: Yes... It sounds like you were telling us that a Hypogean is hiding in a tomb somewhere in the Crimson Highlands.
say:40:1111318028:0.source_cn: 嗯……我想，你的预言应该是指深红高原的墓穴中，藏着恶魔。

say:41:1111318029:0.text: Yes, it was much clearer than last time.
say:41:1111318029:0.source_cn: 我赞同。比上次清晰很多。

say:42:1111318030:0.text: A Hypogean? Did I really say that?
say:42:1111318030:0.source_cn: 恶魔？不敢相信我竟然说出了这个词！

say:46:1111318032:0.text: We'd be in trouble if another Hypogean appeared. No, it must be Berial.
say:46:1111318032:0.source_cn: 要是再冒出来一个新的恶魔可麻烦了，一定是贝利尔。

say:47:1111318033:0.text: Berial... It looks like we know exactly who we're fighting.
say:47:1111318033:0.source_cn: 贝利尔吗……看来，我们的敌人已经明确了。

say:48:1111318034:0.text: Be it a monster or Hypogean, no one is a match for us. Come on, our next stop is the Dusk Lord's resting place.
say:48:1111318034:0.source_cn: 走吧，去残阳神的长眠之地。不管是怪物还是恶魔，都放马过来吧！

say:0:1111319001:0.text: Shouldn't we say goodbye to Rhys before we go?
say:0:1111319001:0.source_cn: 去残阳神的长眠之地前，不和诡草打声招呼吗？

say:1:1111319002:0.text: He's still passed out. Just let him rest.
say:1:1111319002:0.source_cn: 他被打晕后还没醒，让他躺着吧。

say:0:1111320001:0.source_cn: 黑金商会的营地？真巧啊。

say:1:1111320002:0.text: Come on, let's go gather some information.
say:1:1111320002:0.source_cn: 走，找他们打听打听消息。

say:2:1111320003:0.text: Do you plan on doing that with your fists? Because it sure looks that way.
say:2:1111320003:0.source_cn: 你这架势，是打算用拳头打听啊。

say:1:1111322001:0.text: Now, tell me about this so-called treasure that everyone's talking about.
say:1:1111322001:0.source_cn: 说说看，你们所谓的宝藏，究竟是什么？

say:3:1111322002:0.text: Bah! You think I'd tell you just because you asked? Keep dreaming!
say:3:1111322002:0.source_cn: 呸！你想知道我就告诉你啊？哪有这种好事！

say:4:1111322003:0.text: If the next words out of your mouth aren't something I want to hear...
say:4:1111322003:0.source_cn: 如果你的下一句话，不能给出我想听到的答案。

say:5:1111322004:0.source_cn: 那么，这就是你的最后一句话了。

say:6:1111322005:0.text: N-No, please. I'll talk! Just don't hurt me!
say:6:1111322005:0.source_cn: 别、别这样，小哥，我说！我说还不行吗！

say:7:1111322006:1.text: My patience is running out, so make it quick.

say:8:1111322007:0.text: The truth is... <style="highlight">there is no treasure</style>!

say:9:1111322008:1.text: Then what exactly is the Adamant Syndicate doing here?
say:9:1111322008:1.source_cn: 那么，黑金商会的目的是什么？

say:10:1111322009:0.text: We want to open the Dusk Lord's tomb.

say:11:1111322010:0.text: We're trying to fool people into opening the tomb for us.
say:11:1111322010:0.source_cn: 我们希望那些上当的人过来，打开残阳神的墓穴！

say:12:1111322011:0.text: The tomb... What are you planning to do with it?

say:13:1111322012:0.text: I-I don't know. Please just let me go...

say:17:1111322014:0.source_cn: 唔……索恩，丝毫没有手下留情呢。

say:18:1111322015:0.text: He passed out from the pain. Should we be worried?
say:18:1111322015:0.source_cn: 那家伙直接痛得晕过去了，不要紧吗？

say:19:1111322016:0.text: Leave him. He'll manage on his own.

say:0:1111323001:0.text: We're getting closer and closer to the truth! I wonder what we'll find?
say:0:1111323001:0.source_cn: 离真相越来越近了，不知道究竟会发生什么呢？

say:1:1111323002:0.text: No use getting worked up about it right now. Let's go.

subtitle:1:1111315109:.text: That bone flute... It's affecting Koko!
